lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Napoleon EscapesNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 16THE NET WAS DRAWN. THE FISH WERE NOT ALL IN ITThe lieutenants go to prison for ten years, fifteen years, life. The Professor goes nowhere at all. The Yard's inquiries lead to Calais, then to Marseilles, then into a long, grey silence. Lestrade says it was a fine piece of work. You say that it was half a piece of work. You are both right. The Professor's chair stands empty in his study at Kensington, with the chess game unfinished, and black to move. In the years that follow, the world remembers a man who kept his friends about him, and who was kinder than he allowed.
